description:
Once you reach a certain level of SELF ESTEEM with women…

You’ll automatically start to filter by -

“excitement to be around me”

Why?

Because there’s nothing to prove.

Really consider why you’re trying so hard to win someone over, it’s either

- lack of options
- Lack of self worth

And notice how both of those feed into each other? 

Figure out your internal world and EVERYTHING becomes easier

Simple
transcript: The lower your self-esteem, the more this will be true for you. When a girl really likes you, you're like, well, that's all right. I don't really care for it. But when a girl is playing hard to get, you're 100% invested, right? You're going after it. You're chasing her down. You're trying to win her over. And the underlying reason why that's true and why that's happening for you is because you don't feel worthy. You don't feel good enough. You don't really even like yourself. So when someone likes you, you think they're making a bad decision on a subconscious level. You're like, why would you like me? But when someone's running away from you, when someone doesn't like you, let's say, and you're chasing after them, they're actually confirming your lack of self-worth. And now subconsciously you're thinking, this is my opportunity to prove myself. If I could just win this girl over, I would finally be good enough. And that's not how it works. When you have self-esteem, when you really like yourself, you automatically gravitate toward people that like you. You don't try and prove yourself anymore. You already feel good enough. So that sense of trying to win people over disappears. You're just being who you are. like you. You don't try and prove yourself anymore. You already feel good enough. So that sense of trying to win people over disappears. You're just being who you are. And that's where your dating life gets very easy because you don't want to filter for trying to prove yourself. You want to filter for who fits into your life, who actually likes you for you.
